 OBSESSION Director Curry Barker Is Back Just In Time For Halloween
 Fangoria Amber T Add to Preferred Sources Updated Thu, October 29, 2026 at 3:56 PM UTC With the hype around Obsession still high (and potentially on its way to the Oscars ), Curry Barker is wasting no time getting back into horror with a brand new short titled Mama Bear .
 Made in collaboration with and sponsorship from Windows, Mama Bear stars Jon Lee Richardson as Floyd, Katie Sarife as Lacey, Ericka Kreuz as Ms. Wilson, and Joshua Snyder as Floyd's Doppelgänger. The short also sees Barker reunite with Obsession production designer Vivian Gray.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Published on the same YouTube channel, that's a bad idea, that Barker cut his teeth on horror with the viral short Milk & Serial , Mama Bear feels like it could easily be set in the same universe as Obsession , shadowy contorted figures and all. Check it out below:
 Barker's FANGORIA Chainsaw Award-winning Obsession became the unexpected horror hit of this year, grossing a gargantuan $505 million at the global box office off a sub-$1 million budget, and officially standing as one of the highest-grossing horror movies ever made. 
 Breakout star Inde Navarette has set a campaign for a Best Actress Academy Award, as part of a huge awards season push from Focus Features . 
 Following his next feature Anything But Ghosts , which hits theaters next year , Barker has his eye on some classic horror IP with a reimagining of Tobe Hooper's seminal The Texas Chain Saw Massacre at A24.
 Stay tuned for more on Barker's upcoming projects as we get it.
